svg.title: SolvAI: source supervision, endpoint fitting and evaluation exposure

g.text: Distil each source into a structure-to-response map
Source targets are computed quantities or empirical measurements
Abraham E, S, A, B, L
Experimental hydration labels supervise the endpoint, not its source targets
Swap the endpoint; keep the response layer fixed
Distinguish endpoint exclusion from source exclusion
Absent from all six supervised sources
Each hydration prediction is out of fold:
its label is excluded from that endpoint fit.
97 is a subset of 220, not a separate fit.
